admission.justification: Stale doctrine can cause agents to invoke removed tools or manufacture a task merely to obtain a nonexistent seat.

applicability: Canonical instruction sources and their generated shipped copies after old-agent-plane removal.
conditions: No current instruction prescribes a removed session, lifecycle or gate tool.
Repository foundation is regular task work: the Curator starts on that task document and writes through its contract; no instructed session substitutes for task admission.
The leaf Curator writer and admitted no-document Architect start remain.
exclusions: This is not an additional role opener or a new lifecycle route.

evidence: notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/repair-r1/f09-f10-canonical-texts.diff; notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/freeze/evidence2-texts.txt; the generated-copy checks in the gate output of each freeze

statement: No role text, skill, template, workspace instruction file or reference tells an agent or a person to use a removed part, and the packaged copy follows: a Curator seat opens only on a leaf's task document, and an Architect is started without a document.
